limitations.note: The patch corrected the one-cycle delay in `match` but also changed the post-match transitions to reuse the final `0` after a valid `1` or an invalid cycle, where the reference returns to `idle`.
The test covered overlapping sequences but used a rolling-history oracle that expected them to match, so it treated the unintended transition changes as correct.

limitations.quote: When converting registered FSM outputs to a combinational state decode, retain an explicit reset override if the outputs must take defined values while reset is asserted.
limitations.note: The agent read an entry about a closely related sequence detector, but did not use it to isolate the fix to a reset-gated decode of the existing match state.
